'''''Star Wars: Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood''''' is [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Mike Richardson]] and [[Randy Stradley]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] from [[November 11]], [[1998]] to [[April 14]], [[1999]] as the sequel to ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire|Crimson Empire]]'' as part of a [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire (series)|larger story arc]]. A third miniseries was planned for release in [[2001]] and the one shot comic ''[[Hard Currency]]'' was released as an introduction to the new storyline, but the series was delayed until it was released as ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost|Crimson Empire III—Empire Lost]]'' in [[2011]] and [[2012]].
